rationale: The feature guide lists its own Cloud Platform/app floors, AWS service regions, explicit enablement, Model Runtime and Enterprise Cloud Connected certificate/connectivity setup. Model Runtime describes external models plus Global versus Data zone routing. The installation and SAIA-9918 pages still exclude Cloud Connected for 2.2.0–2.3.6, offer the separate 2.1.1 fallback without Agent Mode and plan 2.4.0 for late November. About and the Cloud install page establish base app requirements and the specific IL2 limited-support caveat only. A minimum, eligible service region or planned release does not establish a currently usable Enterprise path.
